name: The Valor Family
summary: In Darkshire, Sirra Von'Indi seeks records of Raven Hill's lost people. The village remembers their courage, but her library holds little of Raven Hill's history.

sections.title: A Lost History
sections.body: Sirra Von'Indi says brave people helped Darkshire endure. Lady Althea was among them, as were those who died at Raven Hill. You are asked to search for anything that might preserve their memory.

sections.title: The Tome
sections.body: The book you bring back tells of the Valor family. Sirra offers to copy it and welcomes any other material about them.

faq.q: Who is asking me to search Raven Hill?
faq.answer: Sirra Von'Indi, whose library is in Darkshire, asks you to search Raven Hill for material about its people.

faq.q: Why does Sirra want records from Raven Hill?
faq.answer: Sirra wants Raven Hill's history remembered. It was lost along with the people who lived there.

faq.q: Who does Sirra say helped keep Darkshire standing?
faq.answer: Sirra names Lady Althea and those who lost their lives at Raven Hill as brave people whose actions helped Darkshire endure.

faq.q: What is Raven Hill's history like?
faq.answer: Sirra says Raven Hill's history was lost along with its people. Her library holds little about it.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Valor Family
